<function name="GetSlideX" parent="DSlider" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns the target position of the draggable "knob" panel of the slider on the X axis.

Set by <page>DSlider:SetSlideX</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The value range seems to be from 0 to 1</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
